name: Yolk
description: An egg in your sidebar hatches according to what you type at it, then demands feeding four times daily, accepting nothing but a food emoji. Skip a meal and it departs — so treat it as a light accountability nudge rather than something forgiving.

official.title: Yolk by JP
official.description: A Tamagotchi egg that hatches on what you type. It asks for food four times a day — only a food emoji counts — and leaves the sidebar if you miss a meal.
